books.title: Rex and the Missing Moon Map

cover.heading: Rex and the Missing Moon Map
cover.text: Rex and the Missing Moon Map Cover 1/11 Tap to Start Reading A 10-PAGE ADVENTURE Rex, a cheerful young T-Rex astronaut, and his small robot friend Pip search the Moon for a lost star map. By sharing clues and working together, they find it and follow it home for a well-earned rest. Start Reading Auto-turn pages after narration
buttons: Start reading Rex and the Missing Moon Map

questions.prompt: What clue did Pip spot?
questions.answer: A sparkly corner by a crater

questions.prompt: How did Rex and Pip get the map back?
What had Rex lost?

cover.heading: Luna and the Whispering Forest
cover.text: Luna and the Whispering Forest Cover 1/11 Tap to Start Reading A 10-PAGE ADVENTURE Luna the fox hears a mysterious whisper in the woods. She meets Barnaby the badger and Pip the robin, and together they find a trapped wind sprite. By working as a team, they free it, and the sprite rewards them by making the whole forest bloom and glow. They return home tired but happy, having made the woods a better place. Start Reading Auto-turn pages after narration
buttons: Start reading Luna and the Whispering Forest

questions.prompt: What happened after the friends freed the sprite?
Where did the whisper lead the friends?
What had trapped the wind sprite?

cover.heading: Nia’s Great River Journey
cover.text: Nia’s Great River Journey Cover 1/11 Tap to Start Reading A 10-PAGE ADVENTURE Young elephant Nia travels with her herd along a winding river, meets hippos, kingfishers and buffalo, helps move litter to safety for park rangers, and learns that clean water keeps every living thing alive. Start Reading Auto-turn pages after narration
buttons: Start reading Nia’s Great River Journey

questions.prompt: Who would collect the litter?
Why did Nia want to keep the river clean?
questions.evidencePhrase: clean water keeps us all strong

questions.prompt: What litter did Nia find by the river?
questions.answer: An old sack and empty bottles

cover.heading: Bo and the Busy Bee Garden
cover.text: Bo and the Busy Bee Garden Cover 1/11 Tap to Start Reading A 10-PAGE ADVENTURE Bo watches Bea the bee visit the flowering apple trees in Gran’s garden and learns how pollen can help some flowers grow into fruit. Start Reading Auto-turn pages after narration
buttons: Start reading Bo and the Busy Bee Garden

questions.prompt: How did Bo stay safe while watching Bea?
What sweet drink did Bea sip?
How can pollen help some flowers?

cover.heading: Sami and the Night-Light Parade
cover.text: Sami and the Night-Light Parade Cover 1/11 Tap to Start Reading A 10-PAGE ADVENTURE With Dad close by, Sami follows a family lantern parade and notices the changing sky, moving shadows and a blinking firefly. Start Reading Auto-turn pages after narration
buttons: Start reading Sami and the Night-Light Parade

questions.prompt: What did Tavi do above the grass?
Why did Sami’s lantern grow dim?
questions.answer: A battery had slipped out of place
questions.evidencePhrase: battery had slipped out of place

questions.prompt: What order did Sami remember?

rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Cover 1/11 Tap to Start Reading A 10-PAGE ADVENTURE Mina, Piko and their guide care for a native alpine seedling in a sheltered pot and learn that growth takes time. Start Reading Auto-turn pages after narration

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 1 2/11 Illustration 1 of 10 A SEED PACKET At the mountain hut, Guide Leni showed Mina and Piko a packet of native alpine flower seeds for the porch garden. Mina chose one small seed to plant. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 1 2/11 Illustration 1 of 10 A SEED PACKET At the mountain hut, Guide Leni showed Mina and Piko a packet of native alpine flower seeds for the porch garden. Mina chose one small seed to plant. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 2 3/11 Illustration 2 of 10 A LITTLE POT Leni filled a little pot with clean soil. Mina placed the seed inside, and Piko covered it gently. They set the pot where the porch was sunny and sheltered. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 3 4/11 Illustration 3 of 10 A CAREFUL WATER Mina poured a little water onto the soil. “Seeds need water, air and warmth to begin growing,” Leni explained. The friends placed the pot beside the sunny window. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 4 5/11 Illustration 4 of 10 NO CHANGE YET The next morning, the pot looked just the same. Mina drooped her ears. “Maybe I did it wrong,” she said. Piko sat beside her and waited for Leni’s answer. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 5 6/11 Illustration 5 of 10 SEEDS TAKE TIME “You cared for it well,” said Leni. “A seed can take many days to sprout. After it grows, the young plant needs light and water.” Mina felt hopeful again. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 6 7/11 Illustration 6 of 10 ONE DAY AT A TIME Each day, Mina checked the soil and watered it only when it felt dry. Piko kept the pot away from the windy edge. They cared for it patiently. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 7 8/11 Illustration 7 of 10 A GREEN SHOOT One morning, a tiny green shoot poked through the soil. Mina called Piko and Leni. They smiled, then measured the shoot beside a small twig without touching it. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 8 9/11 Illustration 8 of 10 NEW LEAVES More days passed, and two small leaves opened. The shoot stood taller in the light. Mina drew its shape in a garden notebook while Piko watched the page. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 9 10/11 Illustration 9 of 10 A GARDEN NOTE Mina added the date beside her drawing. “It grew a little since last time,” she said. Piko compared the picture with the plant, and Leni praised their careful watching. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help

rows.heading: Mina’s Mountain Seed
rows.text: Mina’s Mountain Seed Page 10 11/11 Illustration 10 of 10 FOR THE NEXT HIKERS Mina left the growing plant on the hut porch for everyone to enjoy. She had learned that seeds need care and time. The mountains still had many patient stories. Hear page Replay Read-aloud story Word help
